rule: Every existing Titan is redesigned for solo combat. No normal mission allows multiple player Titans active at once.
designPrinciples: Every Titan can independently survive and win

titans.name: Aten-Ra, Solar Law Monolith
titans.uniqueMechanic: AtenRa's Solar Power: a solo charge meter that grows when the Titan uses illuminated terrain to control enemies instead of relying on allies.
titans.basicAttack: Sunder Blow: identity basic attack that generates Momentum when used from advantage terrain or against the Titan's marked target.
titans.movementAbility: Gate Step through illuminated terrain, ignoring one engagement zone and leaving a tactical imprint.
titans.defensiveAbility: Defiant Frame: reduce incoming damage and prime a reaction if surrounded.
titans.offensiveAbility: Marked Cataclysm: detonate the Titan's unique mark for burst damage and control.
titans.reactionAbility: Brace and Break: when charged, reduce impact then counter into nearby terrain.
titans.signatureAbility: Aten-Ra Signature: transforms Solar Power into a battlefield rule for 2 rounds, changing how enemies path and how executions pay out.
titans.divineAscension: Divine Ascension — Judgment Light Unbound: the Titan enters Ascendant stance, amplifies Solar Power, alters nearby terrain, unlocks an empowered signature, and creates a decisive victory window without making the Titan invincible.
titans.executionMechanic: Execute — AtenRa Verdict: restores health through conquest; bonus payoff if the enemy was made vulnerable through illuminated terrain.
titans.passive: Lone Legend: gains bonus Momentum when ending a round without allied Titans on the battlefield; Aten Ra passive is rewritten for solo play as personal mastery rather than Titan support.
counterplay: attack from multiple timings instead of one burst
